newsitem.title: USA: U.S. anti-smoking group seeks tobacco hearings.
newsitem.headline: U.S. anti-smoking group seeks tobacco hearings.

text.p: The anti-smoking group Campaign for Tobacco-free Kids on Friday called on members of Congress to hold hearings to question tobacco industry executives on recent admissions by Liggett Group that tobacco was addictive, caused cancer and was marketed to minors.
The admissions came in a settlement last month between Liggett, a unit of Brooke Group Ltd, and 22 states.
The group scheduled a news conference Monday with Oregon Democratic Senator Ron Wyden to unveil a national advertising campaign targeted at congressional leaders to push for the hearing.
